title: Direct and Indirect Speech: Mixed Quiz 148
content:
## Put the following into indirect speech

1. The lame beggar said, “This is my horse.”
2. She said, “What’s the time?”
3. Father said, “Let’s eat out tonight.”
4. He said, “Do you like old songs?” And I said, “Yes.”

## Answers to Quiz 147

1. She told me that she thanked me.
2. She thanked me.
3. King Midas asked his daughter to fetch him some water from the well in his golden jug.
